info.title: ROX Agency — Backend API
info.summary: Contract for the backend that replaces the prototype localStorage stores.
info.description: Every request/response body the ROX frontend sends and expects. Field names, types and enum values mirror src/lib/client-store.ts, content-store.ts, portfolio-store.ts and the corresponding hooks (use-admin-portal, use-client-auth, use-admin-auth, use-portfolio, use-site-content) so swapping the local read/write helpers for HTTP calls needs no UI change. Usable with any OpenAPI 3.1 codegen (openapi-typescript, orval, openapi-generator) or simply as the shared team contract.

Conflict.description: Unique constraint violated (e.g. duplicated email or slug).

error.message: Un compte existe déjà avec cet e-mail.

code.description: Stable machine code: unauthorized | forbidden | not_found | conflict | validation_error | rate_limited | internal_error.

accessToken.description: Present when the client uses Bearer auth; absent with the cookie flow.

OrderPhase.description: Matches src/lib/client-store.ts PHASES ids. Display labels come from the frontend registry, not the API.

clientId.description: Server-derived from the session; never trust the client.

service.description: One of src/lib/client-store.ts SERVICES ("Création site web" | "SEO local" | "Figma" | "WordPress / Elementor" | "Hébergement").

AdminOrder.description: Order flattened with its client for admin list views (matches useAdminPortal().allOrders).

from.description: Set by the server from the session role.

orderId.description: Optional thread scoping to one order.

clientId.description: Admin-only: target a specific client's thread.

PortalData.description: Client-scoped aggregate persisted today under localStorage `rox-client-data:<clientId>`.

month.description: French short month label used by the chart (Jan, Fév, ...).

PortfolioItemInput.description: Body for POST /portfolio and PATCH /portfolio/{id}. `createdAt` and `id` are server-managed.

IconKey.description: Keys of src/lib/service-icons.ts SERVICE_ICONS. Send the string only; the client maps it to a lucide component.

slug.description: URL segment for /services/<slug>. Server should enforce uniqueness.

faqKey.description: Which FAQ group the detail page renders (key into /content/faqs).

ServiceInput.description: Body for POST /content/services and PATCH /content/services/{id}. `id` is server-managed.

FaqGroups.description: Map of group key → list of Q&As. Groups seen today: general, home, methode, apropos, portfolio, contact, seo, web, figma, wordpress, hebergement. New groups may be added by the admin.

SiteInfo.description: Coordinates + service area + pricing disclaimer. Empty strings mean 'not yet configured' — the public UI hides any empty coordinate rather than showing fake data.

whatsappEnabled.description: Shows the site-wide floating WhatsApp bubble when true (also requires a non-empty whatsapp number).

whatsappMessage.description: Optional pre-filled message appended to the wa.me link.

whatsappPosition.description: Screen corner the bubble docks to.

SiteContent.description: Aggregate shape persisted today under localStorage `rox-site-content`. Exposed read-only as GET /content (rarely used — the granular endpoints above are preferred), written only through the granular admin routes.

x-conventions.contentNegotiation: Always application/json, UTF-8. Empty string fields are meaningful (used to hide unset coordinates).
x-conventions.identifiers: Opaque strings (UUID v4 recommended). Frontend already uses prefixed ids like `c_…`, `p_…`, `svc_…` — those stay valid but the server may generate its own.
x-conventions.timestamps: ISO-8601 UTC (RFC 3339). UI formats to fr-FR on display.
x-conventions.roles: Two roles: `client` and `admin`. Endpoint scoping is enforced server-side — never trust a clientId from the body when the caller is a client.
x-conventions.sorting: Server returns arrays already in display order (services = card order, portfolio = featured first then newest, history/messages/requests = newest first as today).
x-conventions.pagination: Currently not required (small datasets). If added later, use cursor-based: `{ items, nextCursor }`.
x-conventions.errors: See /components/schemas/Error. Every non-2xx response uses that envelope.
x-conventions.caching: GET /content/* and GET /portfolio are cacheable by CDN (public SEO content). Portal/orders/messages/bookings must be `Cache-Control: private, no-store`.
x-conventions.idempotency: POST /orders and POST /bookings accept an optional `Idempotency-Key` header.
x-conventions.rateLimits: Suggested 60 req/min per IP on public content, 300 req/min per session on authenticated routes.
x-conventions.cors: Allow SITE_URL origin (https://rox.ma) + localhost:8081 in dev.
x-conventions.localization: Server messages, validation errors and content strings are in French. The API is not i18n'd — content is authored in French by the admin.

x-migration-notes.summary: How the current prototype maps to this contract.

replacements.endpoint: GET /content/services?includeDrafts, GET /content/plans, GET /content/faqs, GET /content/info — one call per section, cached at the router level. Public SSR should call the anon variant (no drafts).

replacements.prototype: advanceOrderIn(...), toggleTaskIn(...), setOrderStatusIn(...), markRequestHandledIn(...), appendRepReplyIn(...), confirmBookingIn(...)

preservedAcrossSwap: Field names, enum values and shapes are identical to the localStorage stores.
Public pages read only published content: /portfolio (published=true), /content/services?published, /content/plans, /content/faqs, /content/info.
Server must generate ids, createdAt and infer `from` on messages from the session role — do not accept them from the client.
Slug uniqueness (services) and email uniqueness (client accounts) should be enforced by the server, returning 409 conflict.
